highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too, so that OpenBot credit models, paused workflows, WhatsApp read-only chats and location requests work there.
Buy OpenBot credits and use OpenBot image and video models in workflows, with up to 4 results at a time.
Pause a workflow, or export it to a file and import it on another computer or server.
An agent can ask for your location when a request needs it, such as restaurants near you.
Make an allowed WhatsApp contact or group read only: your agents can read it, and OpenBot never writes there.
